entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold while we connect you with the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold for ten minutes. I need to return this jersey I bought. It's completely useless to me.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. To get started, can I have your name and order number please?
The name is Sam Jones, order number is VF8675309. Look, I don't have time for a runaround. I want to return this, and I want my money back now.
Thank you, Sam. I'm pulling up your order now. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Are you kidding me? It's the wrong size! It's so tight I can barely breathe in it. This is unacceptable! I want a refund or an exchange, and if you can't do it, get me your manager right now! I'll blast this all over your social media.

I understand your frustration completely, Sam. A jersey that's too tight is definitely not what we want for our customers. Let me just take a look at the delivery date here... okay, I see it was delivered about 68 days ago.

I don't care if it was a hundred days ago! Your policy is supposed to be good! Are you going to help me or are you just going to waste more of my time? This is the last time I buy anything from VeloFit.

I can absolutely help you, Sam. There's no need for a manager. I've just confirmed our policy. Since this is a standard item, you are well within our 90-day return window. We can definitely get this processed for you.
Yes, that's correct. I can start a return for a full refund, or if you prefer, I can set up an exchange for the correct size jersey right now. The choice is yours.
Well... okay then. Just process the refund. You should have just said that from the beginning. A lot of hassle for nothing.

My apologies for any confusion. I've initiated the return for a full refund. You will receive an email shortly with a pre-paid shipping label to send the jersey back to us. Once it's received at our warehouse, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
